pretreatments.description: Mechanical comminution using a food processor for winery waste (WW) and juice industry waste (JW), and using a universal cutting mill for cotton gin waste (CGW) to achieve a particle size less than 500 μm.
Chemical pretreatment using alkaline reagents: sodium hydroxide (NaOH), sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3), and sodium chloride (NaCl).
Chemical pretreatment using acid reagents: citric acid (H3Cit) and acetic acid (AcOH).
Chemical pretreatment using oxidative agents: hydrogen peroxide (H2O2).
Chemical pretreatment using organic solvents: acetone (Me2CO) and ethanol (EtOH).
Thermal treatment applying temperatures of 25 °C, 60 °C, and 90 °C during the chemical pretreatment process.
